paragraphs: I ride my bike with Sam and Tom. We have bike practice every Saturday in August. We start at eight o'clock in the morning. First, we ride to the park. Then we ride round the lake. Sam has a red helmet. Tom has a blue one. I have a green one. The path is long and green. We are happy on our bikes.

The weather changes our plan. When it is sunny, we ride to the river. When it is cloudy, we ride in the park. A big gray cloud can bring rain. When the road is wet, we do not ride. We go home and clean our bikes. Do you like to ride in the rain? I do not. Wet roads are not safe.

Sam has a birthday in September. It is on the last Saturday of the month. Tom and I want to give Sam a present. Tom says, "A new bag is good." I say, "No, he has a bag. His helmet is old." We say, "A new helmet is a good present." Tom smiles and says, "You are right." We write it in the plan. I like our Saturday plan.
text.summary: Ben writes the plan for his bike friends. Each Saturday in August the weather changes the plan, and in September Sam gets a present.
